name: Complaint theorem export
description: Converts a complaint draft body to First-Order Logic (FOL) predicates, deontic norms, and TDFOL/DCEC temporal formulas, then exports those formulas to Lean 4 and Coq notation for formal theorem checking.

predicates.description: List of predicate dicts produced by text_to_fol or prove_claim_elements.

theorem_export.description: Lean 4 and Coq exports of the TDFOL/DCEC formula set.
